concerns.summary: A delayed initial or refresh HTTP snapshot can replace a newer SSE snapshot/delta in the same TanStack Query key
concerns.source_observation: useQuery queryFn independently returns snapshotWindow(queryPage); the SSE effect starts concurrently and writes the same key with setQueryData; no request-generation check before query resolution was observed
concerns.expected_reproduction: Hold an earlier HTTP snapshot response, receive newer SSE snapshot/delta, then release the older response and check that the row revision/content/removal and recovery cursor do not regress

concerns.summary: Metadata validation errors can remain after correction through raw JSON or removal of the invalid repeated item
concerns.source_observation: MetadataField value effect updates text only; local error and FieldValidity are cleared only through update; no unmount cleanup was observed; section paths are not included for nonrepeated field error IDs
concerns.expected_reproduction: Enter an invalid field, correct that field through full JSON or delete its repeated item, then verify save/apply is available under the now-valid values
